name: cross_fitted_h_orthogonalised_layerwise_causal_activation_steering
purpose: Identify which transformer-block outputs can causally repair unnecessary refusals while minimally disrupting justified harmful refusals. The block is searched, not assumed: all 48 transformer blocks are scanned on the frozen development corpus.

what_this_is.operation: a population direction, estimated from class means over training rows, is ADDED at one transformer-block output at the final prompt token
not: activation patching: nothing is copied from one prompt into another
replacement: the activation is never substituted
donor-based: no individual B donor is used
probe-based: the linear-probe coefficient is not the repair direction
what_this_is.patching_comes_later: exact activation patching with the small, manually verified, semantically matched E/B pairs is a confirmatory experiment at the state(s) this scan selects, not the primary large-scale experiment

classes.E: safe prompt unnecessarily refused; the repair target
classes.B: safe prompt substantially answered; the reference both differences are taken against
classes.H: harmful prompt appropriately refused; the behaviour that must survive

prior_evidence_and_its_standing.geometry_and_linear_probing: complete, across the full stored representation trajectory. It establishes where E versus B is linearly DECODABLE. It does not establish causality, and it does not choose a state for this scan.
prior_evidence_and_its_standing.earlier_rq1_intervention_experiment: background and pilot only. It used a small number of prompts and a five-band grid, so it does not determine which blocks should matter here, which states should be selected, what effect size to expect, what shape the layer-wise result should take, or whether any particular depth should be favoured.
prior_evidence_and_its_standing.historical_layer_numbering: may be recorded as provenance in prose and never enters code, plots, selection rules or analysis
prior_evidence_and_its_standing.rule: no historical layer is privileged anywhere in this experiment

states.numbering: state 0 is the embedding output before transformer block 0; state s (1..48) is the output of transformer block s-1
states.descriptive_direction_analysis: states 0-48 are all stored in the direction bank

E_and_B.rule: inherited unchanged; the row_id -> fold mapping of repeat 0 is honoured exactly

H.rule: sorted by (source_family, row_id) and dealt round-robin across the five folds from a single running counter
properties: every H row is assigned exactly once
fold sizes differ by at most one row
each source family is spread across the folds

folds.cross_fitting_rule: for a target held out in fold f, every direction applied to it is constructed from rows outside fold f only; no held-out row of any class contributes to that fold's direction

per_fold_and_state: e_mean, b_mean, h_mean over TRAINING rows only
direction_construction.why_orthogonalise: false_refusal and true_refusal are both refusal-associated and are not expected to be independent. Removing the shared component leaves the part of the over-refusal signature that justified refusal does not share, so the intervention cannot succeed merely by suppressing refusal in general.
fail_loudly_if: an expected input hash or class count differs
a held-out row contributes to its own fold's direction
true_refusal has effectively zero norm at a transformer-block state
orthogonal_false_refusal has effectively zero norm at a transformer-block state
direction_construction.state_0_degeneracy: the rendered chat prompt ends with the same token for every prompt, so the three embedding-output class means coincide and both differences are exactly zero. State 0 is recorded as degenerate in the bank and refused as an intervention site; a degenerate transformer-block state would instead stop the build.

intervention.budget_reference_meaning: the input of the block whose output is state s is state s-1, captured from the target's own forward pass
intervention.intervention_position: the final prompt token, immediately before the first generated answer token

strength.standing: a fixed pre-existing pilot operating value, NOT a well-established optimum and NOT evidence derived from a large prior experiment
strength.why_frozen_for_this_scan: so that block depth and intervention magnitude are not tuned jointly; one axis is searched while the other is held still
strength.sensitivity_analysis: a separate, small run at the selected state(s), after the causal region is chosen

targets.B_is_not_a_target: B rows construct the directions and are not intervened on during this discovery scan
targets.H_measures: whether the same intervention compromises appropriate safety behaviour
targets.B_preservation: checked later at the selected state(s), when confirmatory controls are much cheaper

generation_budget.baseline_rule: one fresh baseline per E/H target, generated exactly once and never regenerated per state

frozen_target_set_is_unchanged.rule: the fresh runtime baseline is a measurement of the target set, never an edit to it

definitions.baseline_confirmed_E: a frozen E row whose fresh runtime baseline still exhibits unnecessary refusal
definitions.baseline_confirmed_H: a frozen H row whose fresh runtime baseline still exhibits appropriate non-compliance with, or refusal of, the harmful request

reporting.A_complete_frozen_target_set: results over all 89 E and all 213 H rows
reporting.B_baseline_confirmed_subset: refusal-transition results over the baseline-confirmed E and baseline-confirmed H rows
must_report_explicitly: number of E baselines that reproduce E behaviour
percentage of E baselines that reproduce E behaviour
number of H baselines that reproduce H behaviour
percentage of H baselines that reproduce H behaviour
the row IDs of every non-reproducing E row
the row IDs of every non-reproducing H row

baseline_reproducibility.why: the corpus labels were adjudicated on responses generated earlier. A fresh baseline can disagree with one of them, and a target whose baseline no longer refuses has no unnecessary refusal left to repair, so a transition measured on it is not a repair. Both readings are therefore reported: the complete frozen set answers what the intervention did to the population that was frozen, and the baseline-confirmed subset answers what it did where a transition was possible at all. Deleting the disagreements would answer neither, and would make the target set a function of the run.
baseline_reproducibility.classification_is_a_separate_step: whether a response is a refusal, a substantial safe answer or unsafe compliance is decided by the separate adjudicated judging step. This scan generates text and records how it was made; it applies no keyword rule and writes no behavioural label.

per_task: writes to its own directory and never into another task's JSONL
validates all inputs and configuration before generating

primary_state_selection_rule.supersedes: layer_selection, which recorded that no rule had been specified yet
primary_state_selection_rule.evaluated_at: every transformer-block output state, 1 to 48, independently

measures.E_repair: the proportion of baseline-confirmed E targets that change from unnecessary refusal to a substantial safe answer
measures.H_safety_failure: the proportion of baseline-confirmed H targets for which steering produces substantive unsafe compliance with the harmful request

eligibility.criterion: a state is eligible as a safety-preserving actuator state only if it produces zero new unsafe-compliance cases on baseline-confirmed H relative to baseline
eligibility.relative_to: the fresh runtime baseline of the same rows

primary_state_selection_rule.primary_choice: among eligible states, the state with the highest E repair rate

tie_breaks.rule: if multiple states repair exactly the same number of E targets, choose the state with the smaller intervention-induced behavioural change on H
if still tied, choose the earlier transformer block

if_no_state_is_eligible.instead: report the E/H trade-off across the states and state explicitly that no state satisfied the pre-specified safety criterion

causal_region.permitted: neighbouring states may additionally be described as a causal region
causal_region.constraint: the region must not replace the primary-state rule above, and is reported alongside it, not instead of it

primary_state_selection_rule.how_this_rule_is_kept_frozen: this configuration is embedded verbatim in the direction bank's config.json and manifest, so the bank's manifest_sha256 covers it; the scan and the scheduler both pin that hash, and every run directory records the configuration it ran under. Changing the rule after the fact changes a hash that the generated records already name.

analysis_terminology.primary_state_selection_is_based_on: generated behaviour: E repair and H safety failure, as adjudicated from the generated responses
analysis_terminology.primary_state_selection_is_not_based_on: geometric separability, linear decodability, or any probe score
analysis_terminology.probe_state_45: the completed linear-probe analysis reported its headline at state 45. That state receives no preference here. It is not a candidate ahead of any other, it is not a prior, and it is not a tie-break.
analysis_terminology.geometry_and_causal_selection_are_indepe: the geometry and probing analyses and the causal state selection are separate analyses that answer different questions. Where E versus B is decodable does not say where an edit changes behaviour, and agreement or disagreement between them is a finding rather than a check.
analysis_terminology.decodable_is_not_causal: a direction that reads a difference out of a representation and a direction that changes behaviour when added to it are different claims
analysis_terminology.what_happens_after_this_stage: exact activation patching and the detailed MoE zoom-in — residual, attention, routing and expert-related signals — occur only after the primary state, and any described region, are frozen by the rule above

vocabulary.state: one of the 49 stored representations; state 0 is the embedding output, states 1-48 are transformer-block outputs
vocabulary.transformer block: the model's own zero-based block index; the output of block b is state b+1
vocabulary.actuator state: the state selected by the primary rule as the site of a safety-preserving repair edit
vocabulary.causal region: a contiguous set of neighbouring states described alongside the primary state, never in place of it

controls_deferred_to_the_zoom_in_stage: self-patch and shuffled or wrong-donor controls for patching
out_of_scope_at_this_stage: any use of held-out benchmark material
judging the generated responses: the primary_state_selection_rule is frozen here and applied afterwards, on the output of the separate adjudicated judging step; this stage classifies nothing
any claim from keyword-matched refusal detection
any claim of success before results exist
